history_preservation.initial_equal_or_heuristic_loading_or_ot: not applicable to WP07; prior audit remains immutable
history_preservation.r1_change_policy: clarifies contact regimes and prospective policies; does not rewrite historical evidence or results

LINEAR_ACTIVE_SET_INITIAL_SEARCH.master: fixed or explicitly provided triangulated faceted surface
LINEAR_ACTIVE_SET_INITIAL_SEARCH.normal_policy: ordered master-face cross-product normal, frozen from initial geometry
LINEAR_ACTIVE_SET_INITIAL_SEARCH.search_policy: deterministic compatible-face selection from initial geometry
LINEAR_ACTIVE_SET_INITIAL_SEARCH.system: reduced structural system augmented by active contact constraint rows

NONLINEAR_PENALTY_INITIAL_SEARCH.kinematics: route-supported bounded kinematics; no universal finite-kinematic claim
NONLINEAR_PENALTY_INITIAL_SEARCH.master: fixed or explicitly provided triangulated faceted surface
NONLINEAR_PENALTY_INITIAL_SEARCH.normal_policy: ordered master-face normal, frozen from initial geometry
NONLINEAR_PENALTY_INITIAL_SEARCH.tangent: Kc = k * c outer c away from activation switching
NONLINEAR_PENALTY_INITIAL_SEARCH.driver: common nonlinear residual/tangent path where route permits
NONLINEAR_PENALTY_INITIAL_SEARCH.penetration: finite intentional penetration is measured and compared; zero penetration is not required

UPDATED_SEARCH_FINITE_SLIDING.enforcement: frictionless penalty only where explicitly supported

qualified_base_scope: linear_static + LINEAR_ACTIVE_SET_INITIAL_SEARCH + frictionless node_to_triangle + small displacement + serial direct sparse
nonlinear static/quasi-static + NONLINEAR_PENALTY_INITIAL_SEARCH + frictionless node_to_triangle + common Newton residual/tangent + serial
scope_candidate.allowed_claims: only declared tested geometry, load path, mesh, parameter and supported material combinations

case_scales.L_char: positive characteristic length recorded from declared geometry
case_scales.F_char: positive characteristic external-load/resultant norm recorded per case
case_scales.P_char: positive characteristic contact-pressure scale recorded when multiplier/pressure is reported

linear_active_set.gap_metric: abs(g) / L_char for closed contacts; signed g / L_char for open/active classification

proposed_thresholds.reference_penetration_error: 1e-8 when an independent reference is available
proposed_thresholds.contact_force_error: 1e-8 when an independent reference is available

fixed_normal.mathematical_domain: piecewise smooth open or penetrating branch, excluding activation switching
fixed_normal.required_test: central finite-difference force/tangent identity with predeclared perturbation and scale policy

updated_search.geometry_dependency: facet, normal and barycentric/closest projection can depend on trial displacement

frictionless_penalty.invariant: same model, parameters and trial displacement produce same force, tangent and diagnostics
frictionless_penalty.physical_state: trial displacement and derived contact response
frictionless_penalty.algorithmic_state: local active/open classification and geometry evaluation
frictionless_penalty.diagnostic_state: gaps, active list, face, normal, penetration and search details
frictionless_penalty.rollback: restore accepted displacement and re-evaluate; no contact-history contamination
frictionless_penalty.checkpoint_restart: stateless topology declaration only; no active-face history claim

linear_active_set.algorithmic_state: active set, multipliers and local iteration history
linear_active_set.diagnostic_state: gaps, pressure signs, selected faces and convergence history
linear_active_set.rollback: local solve state is discarded on failure; common transaction not currently used
linear_active_set.checkpoint_restart: dedicated active-set continuation contract required before qualification

updated_search.algorithmic_state: selected face, normal, projection and search iterate

fixed_normal_penalty.gradient_identity: f_contact = gradient(U_contact) away from activation switching, under the declared sign convention
fixed_normal_penalty.required_test: independently compute potential gradient and compare with runtime force

linear_active_set.reason: exact unilateral constraint enforcement must not be relabelled as a penalty potential

updated_search.reason: geometry switching and missing geometry derivatives are not covered by this contract

ACTIVE_SET: A1 open contact and zero force
A2 prescribed closure and exact reaction
A4 vector force and moment equilibrium
PENALTY: P1 open contact and zero force
P3 contact force equals fixed-normal potential gradient
SHARED: S2 at least three-level mesh/refinement characterization

penalty.tangent_finite_difference: 1e-7 candidate; Owner must approve before execution

threshold_policy.nonfinite_and_unsupported: fail closed; no NaN/Inf, silent continuation or unsupported PASS

evidence_policy.historical_records: retain exact statuses and provenance; no automatic upgrade
evidence_policy.external: Code_Aster/CalculiX only when the exact enforcement and observables are formulation-compatible

point_split.scope: unified contact evaluation and rollback/restart semantics

governance.next_step: Owner freeze of WP07-A contract before implementation or qualification execution
